title: New Year's Eve fondue (red Meltie mug, silver bar cart) — NYE 07
notes: New Year's Eve restage 07 of the "I love this mug!!" Short (shorts/uMl76XX7epo): RED variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos), on the mirrored bar cart top (a gold mirrored bar cart on New Year's Eve, glass shelves with crystal glasses and plain unlabelled bottles, silver balloons and fairy lights behind). New Year's Eve decor instead of pumpkins; reworded NYE hook. The pour and the last dip spill on purpose. Laptop: generated fictional New Year's film stills (no real footage); plain unbranded red bag; no brand labels on bottles; Sora audio.
hook: When the clock hits eleven and

setting.style: Festive New Year's Eve night at home, at a BAR CART CORNER: everything happens on the mirrored bar cart top; a dim festive room lit only by fairy lights and the candle, deep soft shadows, no bright studio light. Handheld vertical phone video at table height, shallow depth of field, rich warm gold-and-black party colour grade with sparkle. Hands have long glossy deep-red manicured nails. The laptop screen is always flat chroma-key green. No on-screen text, no logos, no readable numbers.
